target_units_solver: relative correction y/base - 1; NOT original-unit RMSE
solver_limitation: Generic solver kernels omit production reconstruction and sample weighting; p prefixes are computational controls, never validated feature selection.
comparison_limitation: Default or historical architecture versus externally selected procedure need not improve speed or this development diagnostic loss. These benchmarks do not establish predictive improvement.
complexity_feature_count: The 220-column transport schema is not learner p: classical/tree designs use 6*input_window+7; historical HAR uses 44 and new HAR 43. Inspect design_columns for each architecture.
matrix_search_timing_limitation: The primary matrix resumed from 3 to 6 concurrent workers, recorded in execution_resume.json; search and outer-fit wall times are descriptive under variable load. Controlled benchmarks run serially with one numerical worker.
chronological_rows: First 200/400/600 of the 660 eligible development origins; the common final 32 diagnostic rows are excluded from every fit, with an explicit minimum seven-origin purge
memory: Sampled current-process RSS plus Python-traced allocations; no worker RSS; instrumentation affects timings
